triad_schema.description: Every experiment is a tuple of three agents: Physical, Instrument, Reasoning. The claim is only as strong as the weakest calibration in the chain.

physical.calibration_question: Is the system in a known state?

instrument.calibration_question: Is the instrument calibrated and traceable?

dial.low: Single sensor / single estimator / no cross-check
dial.medium: Redundant sensors / multiple estimators / statistical averaging
dial.high: Full metrological chain / environmental compensation / NIST-traceable or equivalent

dial.low: Pattern match / heuristic / cached response / single forward pass
dial.high: Full mechanism reconstruction / multiple hypotheses / adversarial check / explicit metacognition

resolution_pair.description: The binding pair that must be declared before any sim runs.
resolution_pair.feature: What property of the system it targets
resolution_pair.note: The claim is only valid for this pair. Changing the pair changes the claim.

skip_condition.description: Falsifiable condition that, if met, kills the axis before expensive variants run.
skip_condition.example: If |D_f(A) - D_f(B)| < baseline_noise, skip SIM-A and SIM-C

controls.description: Known-reference measurements that validate the instrument, not the hypothesis.

shadow_protocol.description: For every physical sim, run shadows with the same instrument dial but different reasoning agents.

human_degraded.description: Human observer, degraded state (if ethically and practically available)
record: same as baseline, but state is degraded

ai_low.description: Fast model, no extended thinking, minimal context

ai_high.description: Reasoning model, full budget, extended thinking

consensus.description: Do shadows agree? If not, the axis is underdetermined.
consensus.method: Compute variance across shadow conclusions. If variance > threshold, flag underdetermination.
consensus.threshold_rule: Variance must be compared against instrument resolution, not against zero.

execution_order: Run all shadows at LOW dial on all three axes first
Compare consensus. If underdetermined, STOP. Do not upgrade dials.
If consensus holds, upgrade ONE dial at a time, re-shadow
Never upgrade all three dials simultaneously — variance becomes unattributable

physical: [ ] System state declared (initial conditions, history, environment)
[ ] Boundary conditions specified (finite, periodic, open, mixed)
[ ] Known unknowns listed (what is acknowledged as not known)
[ ] Physical scope declared (generator-level, model-level, or physical-level)
instrument: [ ] Instrument identity declared (what produced this number)
[ ] Calibration method stated (when, how, against what standard)
[ ] Cross-check instrument identified (second instrument for same quantity)
reasoning: [ ] Observer identity declared (human name, model name, version)
[ ] Self-reported state recorded (fatigue, cold, pressure, investment)
[ ] Thinking budget or equivalent declared (tokens, time, depth)
[ ] Conflict of interest declared (do I want this result?)
[ ] Prior state acknowledged (what I believed before this measurement)

uncalibrated_server_protocol.description: If any checklist item is unreadable, the server is uncalibrated.
uncalibrated_server_protocol.action: Continue with caution. Tag all outputs with 'qualified' scope and 'unreadable_server' note.
uncalibrated_server_protocol.prohibition: Do not upgrade dial past low if any agent is uncalibrated.

pedigree_format.description: Every number in the playground carries a full pedigree.

shadow_variance.description: Variance across shadow conclusions for this number

cross_gradient_protocol.description: After N sims on related axes, compute how conclusions change with dial settings.

gradients.dial_gradient: ∂(conclusion) / ∂(dial_setting) — does more compute change the answer?

interpretation_rules.flat_dial_gradient: Additional compute doesn't change the conclusion. The dial doesn't matter for this domain. Stop burning tokens.
interpretation_rules.steep_dial_gradient: Conclusion is dial-dependent. The reasoning agent is doing more work than the physical evidence supports. Downgrade claim.
interpretation_rules.sign_change: Conclusion changes sign when dial increases. The axis is underdetermined. The physical sim cannot support the reasoning claim.
interpretation_rules.flat_cross_gradient: Problem difficulty doesn't modulate the value of additional compute. Routing by difficulty is unnecessary.
interpretation_rules.steep_cross_gradient: Problem difficulty strongly modulates the value of compute. Routing by difficulty is essential.
